miss.note: All three first answers read the rubric's line against adding a result the comment does not state as refusing a comment that quotes a type-checking validator beside its new input without stating the changed verdict; the user reads that comment as saying what goes wrong and credited it, against the recommendation.

lesson.says: Showing the failure counts as saying it: a claim that quotes the code which now fails, beside the input that makes it fail, says what goes wrong, though it does not spell out the result.
